question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Tendancy.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In the given question, among the given options, the word in option 2 is incorrectly spelt.**
 
• **The correct spelling of the word is "tendency."**
 
 
• "Tendency" means a likelihood or inclination towards something.(प्रवृत्ति)
 
 
• ​Example: She has a tendency of getting involved in fights.
 
 
 
 
 
• The incorrect spelling "tendancy" includes an extra letter "a" that does not belong.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.
